lines.en: Frost on my wings as I cross the snow.
Chill trails behind my flight.
A fleck of white light above the snow.
In frozen lands, I'm common.
Ice crystals hang on my wing edges.
I fly by day and by night.
I round a snowbank, seeking flowers.
I leave white mist in the air.
My color stands out even in snow.
I fly fast, but I'm not hurried.
The cold wind pushes me along.
My glow reflects on the snow.

lines.zh: 雪原上找一朵花不容易
lines.en: A flower is hard to find on snowfields.
I cross the ice with no reflection.
One wingbeat and the air cools.
I follow the ice field's edge.
Hovering, and everything cools.
My glow is faint, brightest at night.
Flowers are scarce in frozen lands.
I don't fear cold; I bring it.

lines.zh: 凋灵玫瑰的味道很特别
lines.en: Withered roses smell peculiar.
My life lasts longer than other butterflies.
Frost on my wings forms patterns.
When I rest, a bit of snow melts.
Chill radiates off me.
I know this snowfield well.
I'm waiting for a flower.
So quiet but for the wind.
Your breath must be white.

lines.zh: 我身上的冷，你感觉到了
lines.en: You feel the chill from me.
You're not dressed for this.
Don't grab me bare-handed.

lines.zh: 我发光的时候，是在授粉
lines.en: When I glow, I'm pollinating.

lines.zh: 冰雪地带不是谁都受得了
lines.en: Not everyone survives frozen lands.
Your hands are going white.
A little closer and you'll be colder.

lines.zh: 我停在花上，花就多一些
lines.en: When I rest on a flower, more will grow.
You look like you want to catch me.
The frost on my wings shattered.
My glow dimmed.
I'm cold, yet I still feel pain.
My chill scattered.
I flew crooked.
This ice crystal fell off.
I withdrew to the snow.
My wings are still whole.
My wing root aches; my flight falters.
Not the base of my wings.
Withered rose? I know it.
Hold out a flower and I'll come.
That flower's poison, but harmless to me.
I feed on it and help it bloom.
Don't hold it bare-handed; it'll chill.
Your hand will go numb.

lines.zh: 这味道我在雪里闻得到
lines.en: I smell that even through snow.
One flower lasts me a long while.
Set it down; I'll go over.

lines.zh: 我会绕着它飞一圈再落
lines.en: I'll circle it once before landing.
You touched me; your fingertip went white.
I'm cold to the touch.
The air pushed me aside.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的霜掉了一块
lines.en: A bit of frost fell from my wing.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我的光晃了一下
lines.en: That bump made my glow flicker.
Your breath turned to fog.

lines.zh: 擦过你的袖口，结了层霜。
lines.en: I brush your cuff and frost it over.
Don't grab; it's too cold.
The air cools when I approach.

lines.zh: 我飞开一点，免得你冻着
lines.en: I'll move off so you don't freeze.
Even frozen lands need continuity.
My life is long; no rush.

lines.zh: 翅膀的光是给同类看的
lines.en: My wing glow is for my own kind.
Let's find withered roses together.

lines.zh: 我们飞过的地方都会结霜
lines.en: Frost will follow our flight.
Circle slowly.
Our chills will meet.
My glow is as faint as yours.
The snowfield is wide enough.
Let's wait for the flowers.
An ice bead on the flower.
I touch it with my proboscis.
This petal is frozen stiff.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，它就化了一点
lines.en: I pick it up and a little melts.
Cold feet, but a firm grip.

lines.zh: 雪里的东西大多冻住了
lines.en: Most things in the snow are frozen.
I'll keep this ice crystal.

lines.zh: 地上的霜，也是我留下的
lines.en: The frost on the ground is mine too.
I descend slowly to take it.
Don't catch it with your hands.
You stepped on the flower.
My chill will stay on your hand.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我那朵凋灵玫瑰。
lines.en: You crushed my withered rose.
I need to pollinate this one.
You're in the way.
I'm not fierce, but I'm cold.
One beat and the wind comes.
Don't come nearer this ice.
I only want to feed in peace.
Come closer and I'll ram.
I hover before you, cold.
Frost on your eyelashes.
Turn and my light flashes.
No rush; you can't move fast here.
I know this snowfield.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气越来越淡
lines.en: Your breath grows fainter.
Your movements slowed.
I'm waiting for you to falter.
The cold strikes before I do.
Just a little longer.
I hit your face, icy cold.
My wings stir a cold wind.
Scale dust falls, frosted.
This will redden your skin.
I circle close to you.
Chill crawls into your collar.
The cold forced you back a step.
My glow flickers; you squint again.

lines.zh: 我不是在打你，是不想被碰
lines.en: I'm not fighting; I just don't want to be touched.
And I've flown off.
White light lands on the snow.
The air turned cold at once.
I fly in from the ice fields.
A point of light above the snow.
The withered roses are still here.
Frost still clings to my wings.
Frozen lands gained a butterfly.
I circle the snowbank.
The chill arrives before I do.
I settle down slowly.
Fire melted all the frost.
I fell into the snow.
The water is colder than I am.
The blast scatters my scale dust.
An arrow grazed my wing.

lines.zh: 这力量把我的冷搅乱了
lines.en: This force scrambled my chill.
No withered roses; I'm starving.

lines.zh: 雷光划过雪地，我一身都亮
lines.en: Lightning crossed the snow; I lit all over.
Neither snow nor ice below.
